what.text: This page follows refugees from Uganda living in Canada, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4393 Ugandan refugees in Canada, 34.3% of all refugees from Uganda.
Canada is the largest host of Ugandan refugees, followed by the United States, the United Kingdom and Kenya.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Uganda in periods from 1989 to 2017, with the LRA and ADF among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group in Uganda in 2022.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at 350 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2024 and 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
These are year-end totals for Canada only, reported to UNHCR.
